title: Use AGV Object Selection and Go-to to recover an AGV (e.g., hospital drop-off) when it is not leaving
summary: When an AGV is not leaving (example recovery: after a tipper goes down), use OptiSweep’s AGV object selection to view the AGV, then use the Go-to function to send the AGV to a chosen square (example: hospital drop-off). After the AGV’s tote is removed, the AGV should pick up a new task.
when_to_use: Use this when an AGV is not leaving and you need a quick recovery by sending it to a chosen square using Go-to (example given: a tipper goes down and an AGV will not leave).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the OptiSweep UI actions (select AGV object, select Go-to, choose square, Confirm) and perform the remove/add AGV example recovery sequence as needed.

access_required: OptiSweep HMI/UI access that supports AGV object selection and Go-to
system_preconditions: AGV is visible/selectable in the OptiSweep AGV view/object selection area

visual_references.description: Frame showing object selection under AGV and that selecting the cell phone shows AGV information (used to ground the 'select AGV object' step).
Frame containing the Go-to recovery example text: select AGV, select Go-to, select square, select Confirm; includes hospital drop-off and 'AGV will pickup a new task once it's tote has been removed'.
Frame with additional context around map selection and square/rack-related selection behavior (supports choosing a square).

steps.title: Select the AGV object using object selection
steps.purpose: Choose the specific AGV so the interface displays AGV-specific information and you can issue the Go-to command for that AGV.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep interface, use object selection in the AGV view and select the AGV object (the source example describes selecting the AGV under the AGV view, including selecting the cell phone symbol).
steps.expected_result: The interface shows AGV information for the selected AGV after you select the cell phone/symbol for that AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV information panel/details appear for the selected AGV (not just an unresponsive map click).
steps.failure_condition: Selecting on the map does not result in AGV information being shown for the intended AGV.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “So you have to select the… object selection. You select the object… Now, if you’re under AGV… And you select this cell phone… It’ll show you the AGV information.”

steps.title: Confirm the interface shows AGV information for the selected AGV
steps.purpose: Verify you selected the correct AGV before issuing the Go-to command.
steps.instruction: After selecting the AGV object, verify the AGV information is displayed in the interface.
steps.expected_result: AGV information is visible for the selected AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV information panel/details are present (as indicated by the source behavior after selecting the cell phone symbol).
steps.failure_condition: No AGV information appears for the selected object.

actions.label: Verify AGV information panel
actions.exact_action: It’ll show you the AGV information.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: Selecting the cell phone under AGV shows AGV information.

steps.title: Select the Go-to function
steps.purpose: Open the Go-to control so you can send the selected AGV to a chosen square.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep UI, select the Go-to function for the selected AGV.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to workflow/control is selected so you can choose a destination square and then Confirm.
steps.healthy_condition: Go-to destination selection is available (you can proceed to selecting which square the AGV should go to).
steps.failure_condition: Go-to destination selection is not available after selecting Go-to.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “Select Go to” is part of the Go-to sequence.
The slide frame lists: “Select Go to” as step 2.

steps.title: Select the destination square for the AGV
steps.purpose: Choose where the AGV should navigate as part of the recovery.
steps.instruction: In the square/grid selection UI, select which square you want the AGV to go to (example destination mentioned: hospital drop-off).
steps.expected_result: A destination square is selected as the Go-to target.
steps.healthy_condition: You can proceed to Confirm after selecting the destination square.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot select a destination square or cannot proceed to Confirm.

actions.label: Select destination square
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “Select which square you want the AGV to go to.”
“Select which square you want the AGV to go to” and example: drop it off at the hospital.

steps.title: Select Confirm to send the Go-to command
steps.purpose: Transmit the Go-to command to move the selected AGV to the chosen square.
steps.instruction: Select Confirm to send the Go-to command for the selected AGV to the selected square.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to command is issued (the UI proceeds with the confirmation action).
steps.healthy_condition: After Confirm, the recovery sequence can continue (next step is waiting for the AGV to pick up a new task after tote removal in the example).
steps.failure_condition: After Confirm, the AGV does not move to the selected square (per candidate failure note).
stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “Select Confirm” is step 4 in the Go-to sequence.
The slide frame lists: “Select Confirm” and describes sending the AGV to a square (hospital drop-off example).

steps.title: Example recovery: remove and add the AGV, then Go-to to hospital drop-off
steps.purpose: Apply the source’s example recovery when a tipper goes down and an AGV will not leave.
steps.instruction: Use the source example sequence: when a tipper goes down and an AGV will not leave, remove and add the AGV, then use Go-to to drop it off at the hospital.
steps.expected_result: The AGV is sent to the hospital drop-off square using Go-to as part of the recovery example.
steps.healthy_condition: The recovery example sequence completes: AGV removed/added and then Go-to to hospital drop-off is executed.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not reach the selected destination square after Confirm (stop/escalate).

actions.label: Remove and add the AGV (example recovery)
Go-to hospital drop-off
actions.exact_action: use the go to function to drop it off at the hospital

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: Example: “if a Tipper goes down and an AGV will not leave. You can remove and add the agv and use the go to function to drop it off at the hospital.”
Slide frame includes the same hospital drop-off example and the remove/add + Go-to sequence.

steps.title: Wait for the AGV to pick up a new task after its tote is removed
steps.purpose: Complete the recovery loop by ensuring the AGV transitions to executing a new task after tote removal.
steps.instruction: After the AGV is at the recovery destination (example: hospital drop-off), remove the tote and wait for the AGV to pick up a new task.
steps.expected_result: The AGV picks up a new task once its tote has been removed.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV transitions from not executing to executing a new task after tote removal (observable as the AGV picking up a new task).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not pick up a new task after its tote has been removed.

actions.label: Remove tote (example completion)
actions.exact_action: once it's tote has been removed

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “The AGV will pickup a new task once it's tote has been removed.”
The Go-to recovery example includes: AGV picks up a new task once its tote has been removed.

success_criteria: After selecting the AGV and issuing Go-to (Confirm), the AGV is sent to the chosen square (example: hospital drop-off).
After the tote is removed, the AGV picks up a new task.
healthy_conditions: AGV information is displayed after selecting the AGV object (cell phone selection under AGV).
Go-to destination selection and Confirm are available and can be completed.
After tote removal, the AGV picks up a new task.
failure_conditions: After Confirm, the AGV does not move to the selected square.
After tote removal, the AGV does not pick up a new task.
escalation_guidance: If the AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm, stop and escalate (source provides this stop/escalation trigger but no further troubleshooting steps).
